title: Multi-WAN Load Balancer
summary: Finds every WAN (wired, USB, Wi-Fi, extra Ethernet) and writes an mwan3 policy that shares traffic across all of them. A metric menu sets failover priority.

items.title: Install Dependencies
items.description: Installs mwan3 with opkg on OpenWrt 24 or apk on OpenWrt 25 when it is not already present.
items.usage_tip: Skip this when mwan3 status already runs.

items.title: Setup USB Tethering WAN
items.description: Registers the first USB tethering interface (detected by kernel driver: rndis_host, cdc_ether, cdc_ncm, ipheth; fallback usb0) as wan_usb with metric 20.
items.usage_tip: Hardware & USB Tethering (Main menu -> 2) offers device choice, metrics and toggling.

items.title: Setup Wi-Fi Hotspot WAN
items.description: Connects the router as a client to a phone hotspot or another Wi-Fi network and adds it as wwan with metric 30.
items.usage_tip: Station mode never touches your Access Point interfaces.

items.title: Apply Dynamic Load Balancing
items.description: Finds every enabled WAN, tracks 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 on each, and builds a balanced policy with weight 1 on every link.
items.usage_tip: A link that stops answering those pings is dropped until it recovers.

items.title: Show mwan3 Status
items.description: Prints the current mwan3 interface and policy status.
items.usage_tip: Use it to confirm which links are online right now.

items.title: WAN Metrics
items.description: Lists every discovered WAN and writes network.<iface>.metric.
items.usage_tip: A lower metric is preferred. The failover policy follows that order.
